title: a2a-admission-v0
description: What a relying party's door returned for one action under one signed MUSUBI contract, signed by the relying party. Signed bytes: the ASCII line a2a-admission-v0, a newline, then musubi-canonical-v0 of the record without signatures. Two versions of this record exist: v0 (no rules.version) and v0.1 (rules.version "0.1", 2026-10-10). They differ in presentation_ref (v0.1 may carry self_declared), revocations_seen (v0: sha256 strings; v0.1: objects that say whether each revocation carried an anchor) and the third line of does_not_establish. v0.2 (rules.version "0.2", 2026-10-20) adds immune (the verdict of a2a-immune-v0 as digests and codes) and the reasons immune_hold and immune_reject. v0.3 (rules.version "0.3", 2026-10-27) keeps immune and adds content: the relying party's account of its content check (a2a-content-check-v0) as digests and flags, never the content, and the reason content_scope_conflict. Each later version adds one line to does_not_establish. The seven rules that tie content to decision and reasons are in admission_verify_v0.content_problems. The reference is admission_verify_v0.py; this schema describes the shape and does not replace verify_admission. The implementation of a relying party's door is not public; a record is checked without it. v0.4 (rules.version "0.4", after FURUI blind-06) keeps immune and carries content in the shape of FURUI A7.4 (a2a-content-check-v1): a salted commitment input_commit instead of the content's digest, the decision (stop or pass), the marks (off_topic, rule_conflict), unread, answered and checked, the reason content_off_topic, and two lines of does_not_establish of its own. Its rules are in admission_verify_v0.content_problems_v04.

key_url.description: https URL on the relying party's own domain that serves {public_key_ed25519_b64}.

action_binding_digest.description: sha256 of musubi-canonical-v0({contract_sha256, action, target, amount, nonce, expiry_height}).

sha256.description: v0.1: sha256 of the musubi-canonical-v0 bytes of the material the applicant handed over, null when it has no canonical form. v0: the value the adapter reported.

verified.description: Computed by admit() from the material (v0.1). null means not verified. admit never reads null as true.

self_declared.description: v0.1 only. The item carried fields other than adapter and material: a result somebody else claims to have computed. The request was refused; these are the names of what was brought.

revocations_seen.description: The revocations admit() obeyed. v0: sha256 of each record without its anchor. v0.1: one object per record, saying whether it carried an anchor and the height that anchor states.

sha256.description: sha256 of the revocation record without its anchor.

anchored.description: false: the principal signed it and it was obeyed, and its time is not proven.

height.description: The height its anchor states, as stated; null when it has none. admit() does not check the anchor proof.

clause.description: The grant entry that decided, as a path, for example grant.authorized_actions[2].

evaluator_sha256.description: sha256 of clause_eval_v0.py, the clause evaluator settle imports too.

version.description: Absent in a record written by admit v0.

publication.description: Optional. The relying party's signed consent to publication. The intake stores only records that carry it.

immune.description: v0.2 and v0.3 only, and required there: the immune rules' verdict over the request (immune_v0.py), digests and codes only.

oneOf.description: v0.3 only, and required there: what the relying party says its content check read. Digests and flags; the content is never in the record. null means absent.

input_sha256.description: sha256 of the musubi-canonical-v0 bytes of the content the door received; null when none came

check_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical bytes of the check's own record (furui-check-v0); null when there is none

rules_sha256.description: the identifier of the rule set (furui-rules-id-v0), the value the door's policy names

scope_sha256.description: the task scope the check was given (musubi-scope-v0); null when none was given

answered.description: false when the model returned no answer (a refusal before reading)

checked.description: true only when the content and the check's record were both there, the digests matched and rules_sha256 is the policy's

oneOf.description: v0.4: the content check of FURUI A7.4 as a salted commitment, digests, the decision and the marks; the content and its salt are never in the record. The nine rules are in admission_verify_v0.content_problems_v04.

input_commit.description: sha256(r || musubi-canonical-v0 bytes of the content), r a 32 byte salt the door returns to the requester alone; null when unchecked

check_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical furui-check-v1 record the door read

rules_sha256.description: the identifier of the rule set (furui-rules-id-v1), the value the door's policy names

scope_sha256.description: the scope rendered from the contract (musubi-scope-v0); required when a mark is set
